This is the larger 400-liter carbon overwrapped pressure vessel (COPV) that will go in the passenger seat in the rocket trim of @Tesla's Roadster, which is why this version is a one-seater. Combined with a 200L tank in the rear, available only on the Thrust and Rocket trims, the Rocket trim will have a total capacity of 600L.

Rocket trim comes with 10 total thrusters around the vehicle: Four rear-facing, four downward-facing, and two side-facing.

• Performance trim: Four rear fans, suction system and front and rear deployable skirts.
• Thrust trim: Four rear fans, suction system, front and rear deployable skirts & four rear-facing acceleration thrusters (with 200L COPV tank).

text:
Number one, everybody knows crypto is volatile, but crypto is different things. On the most least volatile of that metric, you would call stable coins the safest right now. Why? Because it's legal through something called the Genius Act, and it's backed by US Treasury. So it's really digital money. 

Now, a little more risky and a lot more volatile is of course, Bitcoin. It is a risk asset so you're buying it as a speculator. Unfortunately, it is not yet a hundred percent legal because the Clarity Act has not been passed. That's law in Congress. We want that to happen. So most institutions haven't really touched Bitcoin yet. 

Third on the hit parade of crypto you should know about are called blockchain tokens. That's something like Ethereum. Blockchain is nothing more than enterprise software. When you think about enterprise software, all that matters is adoptions. Unfortunately, although we've been talking about it for twelve years, virtually no one's using blockchain yet. But that could change.
